milestone: EB0.3 — PumpPortal Birth Valuation & First-Seen Opportunity Audit
x78_40_protection: No service was restarted and no production flag was enabled. The active X78.40 qualification window remains untouched.

observed_or_handled_create_payload_field.note: The listener retains raw retry payloads only when the primary birth insert fails. There is no durable normal-path raw PumpPortal payload archive.

field_matrix.derivable: requires creation transaction or additional provider fields

semantics.market_cap_sol: PumpPortal supplies marketCapSol on the received create event. Existing code does not document whether this is pre-buy or post-buy state, and no deterministic formula is retained to reconstruct either side.
semantics.pre_vs_post_creator_buy: NOT DETERMINABLE from currently retained evidence.
semantics.sol_usd: No contemporaneous SOL/USD value is present at normal birth persistence. Historical USD conversion must not use current SOL price.

historical_recoverability.classification: D — NOT_RECOVERABLE for exact birth MC; later first_observed_mc and market_cap_highest are not birth valuation evidence.

future_contract.checkpoint_recommendation: Do not reactivate broad price tracking. Prefer a later bounded subscription or selected-candidate checkpoint design; all-birth Helius polling would scale with roughly 18 births/minute and is explicitly rejected.

shadow_instrumentation.implementation: src/core/pumpportal_birth_audit.py now accepts the already-received market_cap_sol, virtual_sol_reserves and bonding_curve values and appends them only when EB0_1_BIRTH_AUDIT_ENABLED=1.
shadow_instrumentation.runtime_cost: One bounded in-memory enqueue and append-only file write per create event; zero RPC, zero DB writes, zero Creator Funding actions, zero scoring.
shadow_instrumentation.deployment: HOLD. It requires a listener restart and must not be deployed during the active X78.40 window.
shadow_instrumentation.rollback: Keep EB0_1_BIRTH_AUDIT_ENABLED=0 or restart the listener with the flag disabled after X78.40.

verdicts.birth_mc_reconstruction: D — NOT_POSSIBLE historically; live first-seen provider MC can be captured without RPC but its pre/post-buy semantics are not established
verdicts.first_seen_mc: B — MEASURABLE_WITH_LIMITATION after deferred shadow deployment
verdicts.historical_recoverability: D — NONE for exact birth MC
verdicts.future_all_birth_capture_cost: A — NEGLIGIBLE for retained PumpPortal fields only

tests: tests/test_eb0_1_pumpportal_birth_audit.py — 2 passed; shadow collector remains disabled in production.
